name: Takinogawa-Itchome
tagline: Tokyo in 31 minutes and Shinjuku in 33 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Kita City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 35 minutes to Otemachi, 33 minutes to Shinjuku, 38 minutes to Shibuya and 46 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 16.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 16.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 16 m to 24.4 m, a difference of 8.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 桑原病院, about 22 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 愛誠病院, about 24 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line).
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line). It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Asukayama; for safety, Takinogawa-Itchome.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takinogawa-Itchome. It is served by the same lines as Takinogawa-Itchome. To Shinagawa, for instance, Asukayama is 3 minutes quicker. On safety, Takinogawa-Itchome comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Takinogawa-Itchome is ahead on how close the centre is, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Takinogawa-Itchome. It is served by the same lines as Takinogawa-Itchome. To Toranomon, for instance, Nishigahara-Yonchome takes 3 minutes longer. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

People living alone who want to hold the rent down

noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
明治通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 7 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Sakura Tram (Toden Arakawa Line) serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
